description: Defines the CartItem entity class for the shopping cart system, including fields for cart reference, product reference, quantity, and JPA annotations for persistence.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Entity representing an item in a shopping cart, with relationships to Cart and Product entities, and persistence annotations.

methods.name: CartItem
methods.description: Constructor for creating a CartItem with a specific product and quantity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the cart item.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Retrieves the cart associated with this item.

methods.name: setCart
methods.description: Sets the cart for this cart item.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the product associated with this item.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the product for this cart item.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Retrieves the quantity of the product in this cart item.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product in this cart item.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare CartItem objects based on 'id'.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode. Returns a constant value, consistent with the equals implementation.
